parameters.name: BackupDbNames
parameters.description: The list of databases to back up if you perform a database-level backup. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).

parameters.name: BackupLevel
parameters.description:
The backup level. Valid values:  
* instance: instance-level backup    
* db: database-level backup.

parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description:
The backup mode. For more information, see [Backup modes](~~108631~~). Valid values:

*  phy: fast backup
* logic: consistent backup.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the DRDS instance.
